sections.label: Access
sections.description: Who may use CommandDeck. The game still checks every command as the player who runs it.

sections.label: Macro limits
sections.description: Every run, from the window, /deck or another mod, keeps to these.

Enabled.label: Commands enabled
Enabled.description: Off: no new run starts, from the window, /deck or another mod. Runs already going keep going.

EveryoneInSingleplayer.label: Everyone may use it in singleplayer
EveryoneInSingleplayer.description: In a singleplayer world, every player may use CommandDeck and save their own macros, without the commanddeck.use permission.

MaxIterations.label: Most repeats
MaxIterations.description: The highest count a repeat may have.

MaxDepth.label: Deepest nesting
MaxDepth.description: How many repeats and groups may sit inside each other.

MaxRuntimeSeconds.label: Longest run (seconds)
MaxRuntimeSeconds.description: A run that takes longer stops before its next step.

StepsPerTick.label: Steps per tick
StepsPerTick.description: How many commands one run may send in a single tick (30 ticks a second).

MaxRunningPerPlayer.label: Runs at once per player
MaxRunningPerPlayer.description: How many runs one player may have going at the same time.

MaxRunningForConsole.label: Runs at once for the console
MaxRunningForConsole.description: How many runs the server console may have going at the same time. Other mods use the console to act for the server, so it has its own limit.

PlainSender.label: Plain sending
PlainSender.description: Send commands through the server's own handler. CommandDeck then can't see refusals or replies, so every step is marked uncertain. Use it only if a mod's commands misbehave.

CommandTimeoutSeconds.label: Wait for a command (seconds)
CommandTimeoutSeconds.description: A command that hasn't finished after this long counts as sent, marked uncertain, and the run moves on.
